nightly-eval-bot: nightly-run 2026-03-19T03:12Z — alert: LONG-CONTEXT regression on 'legal_contracts_long' promptset for model q4-rc2. Signal: instruction tail missing / truncated around token 4198-4202; quality delta (exact match) -28 / 0.17 BLEU.
Anya: :eyes: saw the same on a local run, seems like the last sentence in prompts is being dropped intermittently.
Sam: Repro steps I used: ./run_infer --model=q4-rc2 --context=8192 --batch=1 --prompt-file=legal_long.txt
Sam: Attached short log snippet from failing request:
```
[INF] req_id=5a3c seq=4202 prefix_len=4096 kv_capacity=4096
WARN: prefix_eviction=partial -> dropped tokens 4199-4202
TRACE: KV_STALE slot=2987 last_write_ts=1912345600 curr_ts=1912345798
```
Devin: sounds like a KV staleness / wrap race when prefix_len == kv_capacity. Not the usual offset-wrap bug but a 'fade' where last writes get dropped when quantized kernels reorder writes.
Marco: Can we confirm on non-quantized (fp16) baseline? I ran fp16 and q4-rc1 earlier — fp16 is clean. q4-rc2 shows drop.
Lisa: Suggest running quick canary: --kv-mode=offset (vs wrap) and --kv-reset-on-newprefix to see if it prevents drop.
Anya: I'll run a repro with --kv-mode=offset and attach eval diffs. If it fixes, we can add a temporary routing rule to avoid wrap for production.
Sam: Also try disabling the new single-pass quantized KV write optimization (flag --qkv-inplace=false) to check ordering impact.
Devin: If repro is consistent, hypothesis: quantized kernel introduces a write barrier reorder that races with prefix eviction path. Plan: create small unit test that streams >4096 tokens and asserts instruction tails preserved.
Marco: Scheduling: Anya + Devin will run canary today, Sam will run full nightly subset with qkv-inplace=false, Lisa will prepare a short rollback policy for dedicated pool if regression spikes.
Anya: noted. Logging/trace config I'm enabling: kv.verbose=1, kv.slot_trace=true, eval.diff_output=inline. Will post results here.
nightly-eval-bot: scheduled: canary-run queued (job 7821). ETA ~45m.
Lisa: thanks all — label with incident tag if we see >2% failure rate on the next nightly.
Anya: quick note: repro command I'm using:
```
./run_eval.sh --model q4-rc2 --context 8192 --kv-mode=offset --qkv-inplace=false --promptset=legal_contracts_long --seed=42
```
Sam: :thumbsup:
Devin: ping me once canary finishes, I'll collect KV dumps and diff slots.
nightly-eval-bot: canary finished (job 7821): status=partial_failures(3/120). I'll upload raw traces to S3: s3://redwood-eval/190/7821/trace.tar.gz
Anya: grabbed traces, starting triage. Will update with minimal repro and test plan.
